content.title: How many masters has Tiger Woods won?
content.text: Donald Trump Jr. and his fiance, Bettina Anderson, are gearing up to tie the knot. While the exact date of their wedding is yet to be revealed, the couple shared a glimpse inside Bettina's bridal shower this week.The spectacular affair took place at President Donald Trump's sprawling Mar-a-Lago mansion in Palm Beach, with an "Enchanted Garden" theme. The luncheon saw approximately 100 guests gather together at the $564 million estate. The decor oozed luxury, with a colorful floral table arrangement, a three-tired cake, and an abundance of gifts.For the occasion, Bettina donned a strapless, white midi dress that featured a bandeau neckline adorned with delicate silver embroidery. The figure-hugging number was styled with silver pointed-toe pumps.You may also likeMeanwhile, Ivanka Trump donned a pale pink dress that boasted floral embroidery and was cut elegantly at the ankle. Tiffany Trump opted for a sheer blue midi dress that featured intricate lace detailing."Celebrating love, family, and new beginnings at Bettina Anderson's bridal shower this weekend. So grateful to share this happy moment with Arabella, Lara, and Tiffany. And, of course, Donald Trump Jr.," penned Ivanka on Instagram. "How lucky I am. So grateful for you girls," replied Bettina in the comments.Mar-a-Lago estateIn an interview with HELLO!, Melania Trump described the 22-acre oceanfront property as a very happy house, saying, "It's where we got married, which was such a big event, so it is a very special place for us."The property was built by philanthropist and socialist Marjorie Merriweather Post in 1927, and features rare marble, carved stone, gold leaf and eclectic antiques. Donald purchased the 126-room property in 1985, and transformed it into an ultra-exclusive members-only club."We have our own special wing," Melania told us. "It's very beautiful and it’s very private. It's very comfortable because you have everything you need. It has tennis, a beach with a swimming pool, an amazing spa. You can really enjoy yourself and everything is right here. There is a beautiful patio and dining room and it's very elegant."
